verdict.rationale: Bland offers only building blocks. Post-call webhooks notify your server after each call completes. LLM-judge evals grade call quality, and the MCP server can inspect calls and query analytics. Teams could build their own alerting on top of these, but nothing shows live in-call monitoring or native alerts on misbehavior or error-rate spikes. Missing for 10: real-time live-call monitoring, built-in alerting on agent misbehavior, error-rate spike detection or thresholds, and independent hands-on corroboration.
